title: Extruding and Drawing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
description: Set up, operate, or tend machines to extrude or draw thermoplastic or metal materials into tubes, rods, hoses, wire, bars, or structural shapes.

tasks.text: Measure and examine extruded products to locate defects and to check for conformance to specifications, adjusting controls as necessary to alter products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Inspect metal, plastic, or composite products.
Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Start machines and set controls to regulate vacuum, air pressure, sizing rings, and temperature, and to synchronize speed of extrusion.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.
Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.

tasks.text: Determine setup procedures and select machine dies and parts, according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Determine production equipment settings.
Select production equipment according to product specifications.

tasks.text: Troubleshoot, maintain, and make minor repairs to equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Diagnosis aided; physical inspection required

dwas.name: Diagnose equipment malfunctions.
Repair production equipment or tools.
Maintain production or processing equipment.

tasks.text: Change dies on extruding machines, according to production line changes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting tools requires hands-on setup

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Load machine hoppers with mixed materials, using augers, or stuff rolls of plastic dough into machine cylinders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on loading of materials into equipment

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.

tasks.text: Install dies, machine screws, and sizing rings on machines that extrude thermoplastic or metal materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting tools requires hands-on setup

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Operate shearing mechanisms to cut rods to specified lengths.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cutting equipment operation is manual and judgment-based

dwas.name: Operate cutting equipment.

tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of work areas

dwas.name: Clean work areas.

tasks.text: Adjust controls to draw or press metal into specified shapes and diameters.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal and plastic forming equipment run by hand

dwas.name: Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.

tasks.text: Replace worn dies when products vary from specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal and fitting of worn components

dwas.name: Replace worn equipment components.

tasks.text: Test physical properties of products with testing devices such as acid-bath testers, burst testers, and impact testers.

tasks.text: Reel extruded products into rolls of specified lengths and weights.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically packaging products for shipment

dwas.name: Package products for storage or shipment.
